target: Humana — Technology Internship (healthcare data / API; Medicare Advantage Stars / HEDIS quality)
phase: 4/4 - eval + bench + report (all must-have v1 complete, measured)
stack: Python 3.12, FastAPI + uvicorn, pydantic, pandas, pytest + coverage, fhir.resources (schema-validation test only)
hedis_note: HEDIS-style / simplified measure logic, NOT NCQA-certified (representative code sets and windows)
data_path: seeded synthetic FHIR R4 generator (datagen/generator.py, seed=42); Synthea's Java pipeline was impractical (no Java runtime available). Bundles are Synthea-shaped FHIR R4 and validated as schema-conformant FHIR R4B in tests.
tests: 192 passed (pytest); 97% coverage on caregap/ + datagen/ + eval/

gold_cohort_eval.note: Hand-authored ground truth: 1.000 is a correctness/regression result validating measure logic + edge cases (age boundary, out-of-window, missing data, poor control, sex, mastectomy exclusion, deceased). NOT a generalization or real-world-accuracy claim.

throughput_note: engine compute path (all 5 measures per member); excludes FHIR parsing + I/O

latency.methodology: in-process FastAPI TestClient (ASGI), excludes network socket; 200 requests, 20 warmup excluded

unmeasured.network_latency: ___ (latency measured in-process via TestClient, not over a real HTTP/TCP socket)
unmeasured.end_to_end_throughput_with_parsing: ___ (throughput times the engine compute path only; FHIR parse + disk I/O not included)
unmeasured.real_world_gap_accuracy: ___ (forbidden — would require real member/PHI data; gold-cohort figures are correctness-only on synthetic hand-labeled truth)

notes: All Must-have v1 delivered: synthetic FHIR R4 ingest -> clinical model; 5 HEDIS-style measures (CBP/GSD/EED/BCS/COL) with faithful denom/num/rate + per-member status using explicit ICD-10/LOINC/CPT code sets + age/sex/window logic; care-gap detection with reasons; risk-prioritized outreach worklist (gap-count x Stars weight); FastAPI /health /measures /members/{id}/care-gaps /gaps /outreach with consistent envelope + SYNTHETIC tag; hand-built 26-member gold cohort measuring per-measure precision/recall/accuracy incl. all required edge cases. SYNTHETIC data only, never PHI. Out-of-scope (not built): dashboard UI, Stars projected-rating rollup, FHIR MeasureReport output, real claims 837/835 ingestion, ML risk models, auth/HIPAA infra.
